basic_details.job_title: West Karbi Anglong Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Co-ordinator FRA and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren (Government of Assam) is filling 2 temporary posts for its Forest Rights Act (FRA) Cell: 1 Co-ordinator FRA and 1 MIS Assistant /Assistant FRA, for a period of 12 months. The application, in the Standard Application Format with self-attested documents, must be put in the Drop Box at the Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong during office hours on or before 7 November 2026. The selection test will be held at 10:30 AM on 12 November 2026.

qualification.details: The remuneration for each post is fixed and consolidated. No other allowances or benefits will be admissible. | Post Graduate in any discipline from recognized institutions. Masters in Geography/MSW will be given preference. Preference will be given to candidates with a diploma in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing. Knowledge of basic IT/Computer Applications. Experience: work experience in Tribal Affairs will be preferred. Proficiency in the local language will be an added advantage. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-01-2026. | Graduate in any discipline from recognized institutions. Minimum a Diploma in Information Technology (IT)/Computer Application. Preference will be given to candidates with a diploma in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing. Experience: minimum 2 years' domain experience in the area of large-scale data processing and management. Proficiency in the local language will be an added advantage. Age: not more than 35 years. The general eligibility criteria give the limit as not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-01-2026. | The candidate must be a citizen of India, preferably a resident of the state of Assam. The candidate must possess a valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate of the State of Assam. The age of the candidate shall not exceed 35 years as on 01/01/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. | Prior experience in the Government/Private sector in the field of development and project management at National/State Level Schemes or Projects. Proficient data analysis and presentation skills, along with Project Management capabilities. Conversant with the use of social media. Preference will be given to candidates with prior work experience in Government projects/schemes related to Tribal Welfare, Rural Development, MIS management, data handling, or implementation of the Forest Rights Act (FRA). | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are not sent by post or email. They are submitted by hand in the Drop Box placed in the Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren, during office hours, on or before 7 November 2026. Applications received after the last date and time will not be entertained. Fill in the application in the Standard Application Format. The notice does not say where this format can be obtained. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant testimonials, educational qualifications, age proof and experience certificates. Attach a recent passport-sized photograph. Drop the complete application in the Drop Box at the Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong during office hours on or before 07/11/2026. Incomplete applications, or applications without supporting documents, will be rejected summarily. For enquiries, the email address printed on the letterhead of the notice is [email protected] . The notice does not say that applications can be sent to this address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The remuneration for each post is fixed and consolidated. No other allowances or benefits will be admissible. Post Graduate in any discipline from recognized institutions. Masters in Geography/MSW will be given preference. Preference will be given to candidates with a diploma in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing. Knowledge of basic IT/Computer Applications. Experience: work experience in Tribal Affairs will be preferred. Proficiency in the local language will be an added advantage. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-01-2026. Graduate in any discipline from recognized institutions. Minimum a Diploma in Information Technology (IT)/Computer Application. Preference will be given to candidates with a diploma in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing. Experience: minimum 2 years' domain experience in the area of large-scale data processing and management. Proficiency in the local language will be an added advantage. Age: not more than 35 years. The general eligibility criteria give the limit as not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-01-2026. The candidate must be a citizen of India, preferably a resident of the state of Assam. The notice also says the candidate must be an Indian Citizen as defined under Articles 5 to 8 of the Constitution of India. The candidate must possess a valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate of the State of Assam. The age of the candidate shall not exceed 35 years as on 01/01/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Prior experience in the Government/Private sector in the field of development and project management at National/State Level Schemes or Projects. Proficient data analysis and presentation skills, along with Project Management capabilities. Conversant with the use of social media. Preference will be given to candidates with prior work experience in Government projects/schemes related to Tribal Welfare, Rural Development, MIS management, data handling, or implementation of the Forest Rights Act (FRA). Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: Selection will be on the basis of an Interview/Personality Test/Skill Test with a maximum of 100 marks, made up of three tasks: The test for selection will be held at 10:30 AM on 12 November 2026 in the office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the selection process. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DC West Karbi Anglong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Co-ordinator FRA and 1 MIS Assistant /Assistant FRA, both for the Forest Rights Act (FRA) Cell.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be placed in the Drop Box at the Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong during office hours on or before 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Co-ordinator FRA post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized institution and knowledge of basic IT/Computer Applications. Masters in Geography/MSW, a GIS and Remote Sensing diploma and work experience in Tribal Affairs are preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the MIS Assistant /Assistant FRA post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in any discipline, at least a Diploma in IT/Computer Application, and a minimum of 2 years' domain experience in large-scale data processing and management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-01-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Co-ordinator FRA gets Rs. 35,000/- per month and the MIS Assistant /Assistant FRA gets Rs. 25,000/- per month. The pay is fixed and consolidated, and no other allowances or benefits are admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Standard Application Format, attach self-attested documents and a recent passport-sized photograph, and put the application in the Drop Box at the Office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong by 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process and when is the test?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark test made up of a writing skill task (25 marks), a PowerPoint presentation on the Forest Rights Act (50 marks) and a Computer/IT skill and Personality Test (25 marks). The test is at 10:30 AM on 12 November 2026 in the office of the District Commissioner, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for 12 months only, and it gives no claim to regular appointment or absorption in Government service.

faq.question: Q10. Is an Employment Exchange registration required?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must possess a valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate of the State of Assam.
